briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek R2 escalate frontier race as multi-agent systems hit production scale

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race has intensified with three new frontier models released in the past 10 days. Compute constraints and safety gaps remain primary bottlenecks while multi-agent deployments accelerate across enterprise and defense sectors.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4 with native multi-agent orchestration; Anthropic released Claude 4 Opus; DeepSeek R2 achieved 92% on GPQA. Meta open-sourced Llama 4 400B while xAI pushed Grok-3 to 1.8T parameters.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. NIST issued new red-teaming guidelines for agentic systems.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC began volume production of 1.6nm AI chips; Microsoft activated three new 100k H100 clusters in Texas. Google TPU v6 pods reached 10M chips online.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will any single lab achieve reliable 95% autonomous R&D agent performance before 2028?
